test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A square field has an area equal to that of a rectangle of dimensions 36 { m} times 49 { m} . Find the side of the square.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of square = Area of rectangle

Side² = 36 × 49

Side = √(36 × 49)

Side = 6 × 7 = 42 meters

**∴ The correct answer is 42 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Dimensions of rectangle = 36 m × 49 m

Formula: Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth; Area of square = Side²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bafb31ac2baae954d87811ba3921b61bb999430d3c3c3d22614cfe03b215f89.png] 

⇒ Area of Rectangle = 36 × 49 = 1764 m²

⇒ According to the question, Area of Square = 1764 m²

⇒ Side² = 1764

⇒ Side = √1764

⇒ Side = 42 meters

**∴ The correct answer is 42 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Square and Rectangle

Area of a square is calculated as (side)² while area of a rectangle is length × breadth.

Perimeter formulas

Perimeter of square = 4 × side, and Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (length + breadth).

Diagonal of Square

The diagonal of a square with side 's' is given by s√2.
